content.what_it_is: SUBROUTINE INPUT() of EFDC+ (DSI EFDC_Plus, GPLv2 header L1-8): reads the entire model configuration except LXLY.INP, MASK.INP and RESTART.INP (L11-12). Structure: (1) card-image parsing of efdc.inp on unit 1 - for each card the master process (process_id == master_id) calls SEEK('C<n>',0), reads the card with read(1,*,IOSTAT = ISO), echoes it to mpi_efdc_out_unit via FORMAT 1002, jumps to the error handler at label 100 (L3373-3377, prints FORMAT 1001 'READ ERROR FROM FILE EFDC.INP ON CARD' and calls STOPP) when ISO > 0, and then broadcasts every value to all MPI ranks with Broadcast_Scalar/Broadcast_Array. Cards processed: C1 title, C1A mode options, C2/C2A restart-continuation, C3 relaxation/solver, C4 long-term mass transport, C5 momentum advection- diffusion, C6 constituent transport switches ISTRAN(0:8), C7/C8 time integration (NTC, NTSPTC, TCON, TBEGIN, TIDALP, dynamic timestep DTSSFAC/DTMAX -> ISDYNSTP, DT = TIDALP*NFLTMT/NTSPTC), C9/C9A/C10 grid dimensions and sigma layers (IC/JC/LC_GLOBAL, KC, DZCK; MPI domain decomposition follows using domain_coords, IC_DECOMP/JC_DECOMP, ghost rows, Parent_Grid @L495), C11-C11B grid/roughness/depth conversions and corner corrections, C12-C13 turbulence (AHO/AHD/AVO/ABO, GOTM options C12B with Init_GOTM, closure constants VKC..DMLMIN), C14-C14D forcing counts (tides MTIDE, wind NWSER, atmosphere NASER, waves ISWAVE with C14A/C14B, field IFLAGs C14C, parametric cyclone C14D), C15-C21 tidal constituents and open-boundary tide forcing on S/W/E/N boundaries (PFAM/PFPH amplitude-phase -> PCB*/PSB* via RAD = PI2*PFPH/TCP, AMP = G*PFAM, with NPFORT spatial-interpolation variants), C22-C23 constituent/ series counts, C24-C26 volume source/sink BCPS_GL, C27-C31 jet-plume JET_PLM_GL, C32-C32B hydraulic structures HYD_STR_GL/HS_* equation parameters/HSCTL_GL controls, C33-C35 withdrawal-return WITH_RET_GL, C36-C42A sediment configuration (bed mechanics C37 with void-ratio defaults BEDPORC/(1-BEDPORC), cohesive C39/C40 incl. IWRSP==999 tau_crit_coh.inp special case, noncohesive C41/C42 with SETSTVEL/SETSHLD van Rijn fallbacks, bedload C42A), C43A-C45E toxics (kinetics, volatilization TOXS().VOL, sorption ISTOC/DIFTOX, partition coefficients ITXPARW/ TOXPARW/TOXPARB, POC fractions FPOCWST/FPOCBST, atmospheric deposition TOXDEP), C46-C46G buoyancy/temperature/ice/ dye (BSC, TEMO, ice cards C46A/C46B with Edinger wind-function defaults AFWI = 9.2/BFWI = 0.46/CFWI = 2.0, atmospheric cards C46C/C46D, dye classes DYES()), C47-C66 open-boundary concentration BCs (ICBS/CBS_GL etc. for S/W/E/N, bottom and surface, split SAL/TEM/DYE/SFL/TOX then SED/SND via MMAX = 3+NDYM+NTOX bookkeeping), C67 drifters ISPD, C71-C72 output linkage, C84-C87 time-series output stations, C88 high-frequency output, C91/C91A-C91C NetCDF controls; cards C66A/C66B, C68-C70, C73-C83 are placeholders that only set NCARD. NCARD is set to the card label before each read ('1'...'91C') for error reporting. (2) After GOTO 2000 (L3368) it reads the auxiliary fixed-name files: cell.inp/celllt.inp cell-type maps (old 640I1 vs new A5,10000I1 formats, IJCT_GLOBAL/IJCTLT_GLOBAL) followed by Child_Grid and CELLMAP, dxdy.inp cell geometry (DXP/DYP/HP/BELV/ZBR/MVEG with HADADJ+HCVRT etc. conversions, MHK turbine cells MVEGL>90 -> IJLTURB), moddxdy.inp, modchan.inp subgrid channels, ahmap.inp/avmap.inp spatially varying diffusivities, gwater.inp/gwseep.inp/gwmap.inp groundwater, fbody.inp body forces, shellfish JSON, sedrough.inp, partitionw/b.inp, docw/pocw/fpocw/docb/pocb/fpocb/focb/pseudo_focb.inp organic-carbon fields, svhtfact.inp, cold- start initial conditions salt/temp/dye/sfl/toxw/toxb/sedw/sedb/sndw/sndb.inp (each with ISALTYP 0/1 layouts, _Global read + Map2Local(LG).LL mapping), bedmap.inp/sedblbc.inp, bed layer files bedlay/bedbdn/bedddn.inp with unit-conversion flags IBEDLAYU/IBEDBDNU/IBEDDDNU and mass-fraction normalization, then time-series files pser/qser/ qwrs/gwser/sser/tser/dser/sfser/sdser/snser/txser/txdry/txwet.inp into TSxxx structures with TMULT/TOFFSET/ RMULADJ/ADDADJ scale-offset processing, hydraulic-structure tables qctl.inp and control series/rules qctlser.inp/ qctrules.inp (trigger sorting into TRGON/TROFF), atmospheric aser.inp (+atmmap.inp weights), wind wser.inp (+wndmap.inp), ice iser.inp/istat.inp/icemap.inp, shellfish sfbser.inp, vegetation vege.inp/vegser.inp (canopy factors PVEGZ/BDLPSQ), MHK mhk.inp, bank erosion bemap.inp/beser.inp, particle mixing partmix.inp/pmxmap.inp, and finally ReadFields() and ReadCyclones() (L7514-7515). Numerous arrays are zero- or default-initialized inline (e.g. QCTLTO @L1655-1657, HSCTL_GL defaults @L1729-1741, PATMT = 1013.25 etc. @L6720-6731). The file also contains three helper subprograms after INPUT: PARSE_REAL (extracts a real after ':' in a header line), PARSE_LOGICAL, PARSESTRING (token splitter), and READ_SUBSET (subset.inp high-frequency output groups HFREGRP).

verbatim_spans.text: ! *** SUBROUTINE INPUT READS ALL INPUT DATA EXCEPT DATA IN LXLY.INP,
NDRYSTP = ABS(NDRYSTP)   ! *** IF > 0, EFDC+ WILL WASTE ISOLATED CELL WATER AFTER NDRYSTP STEPS
SSG = 2.65         ! *** DEFAULT GRAIN DENSITY USING QUARTZ
AFWI = 9.2    ! *** WIND FUNCTION A, Edinger, et. al. (1974)

unresolved: L1943 vs L1954/L1974: card C37 reads SEDVRDT, but the no-sediment else branch assigns SEDVDRT = 0.0 (L1954) while L1974 assigns SEDVRDT = 0.0 - two distinct identifiers (letter transposition); whether SEDVDRT is a separate global or a defect cannot be resolved from this file (SEDVDRT is also locally declared @L87).

L4106/L4147-L4153: the spatially-constant else branch of the TOXPARB (bed partition) block assigns TOXPARW, not TOXPARB (L4151), duplicating the water-column branch @L4093-L4099; TOXPARB never receives the constant fill.

L4847-L4853: DYE.INP ISALTYP==0 branch loops 'do L = LG,LA_Global' (L4850) using stale LG as lower bound and reads into fixed DYE_Global(LG,K,MD) while loop variable L is unused - inconsistent with SALT (L4758) and TEMP (L4807) analogues which loop 'do LG = 2,LA_Global'.

L5153-L5156: TOXB.INP 'fill any missing layers' loop runs after the per-cell read loop but indexes TOXB_Global(LG,...) with the last value of LG only, so only one cell is filled; contrast per-cell fill in DOCB (L4329-4331).
L4576: FPOCB.INP IREAD==2/ISALTYP/=0 branch uses implied-DO stride NS: (STFPOCB(L,K,NS),K = 1,KBINPUT,NS) - stride is the sediment-class index, inconsistent with stride-1 at L4568.

L911/L927 and L1258/L1279: in the C17 and C21 blocks 'elseif( NPFORT >= 1 )' precedes 'elseif( NPFORT == 2 )', making the ==2 branch unreachable; C18/C19/C20 use '== 1' (L989, L1079, L1168) so their ==2 branches are reachable - asymmetric treatment of NPFORT=2.

L1696-L1699: Broadcast_Array(HS_COEFF, master_id) is called four times consecutively (once per coefficient column?) - Broadcast_Array broadcasts the whole array each time, so three calls are redundant.
L832-L841: card C14D block is headed by comment '!C14C' (L832) and its read (L837) has no 'if( ISO > 0 ) GOTO 100' error guard, unlike other cards; same for C14C read @L808-816.
L4414: 'STPOCB(L,K) = 0.0' executes outside any L/K loop (right after broadcasts @L4409-4411), zeroing a single element addressed by stale loop indices; probably intended STPOCB = 0.0 (whole array).

L7001-L7066: for ISICE==1 the ISER.INP series are read on master (L7004-7035) but the Broadcast block (L7057-7065) sits inside the 'elseif( ISICE == 2 )' branch, so ISER data appear not to be broadcast to other ranks in this file.

L7262/L7286/L7310/L7313: in the MHK block, 'endif' at L7286 closes 'if( NFLAGPWR == 1 )' so 'elseif( NFLAGPWR == 2 )' (L7310) and 'elseif( NFLAGPWR == 3 )' (L7313) chain to 'if( process_id == master_id )' (L7262); consequently the NFLAGPWR==1 broadcasts (L7288-L7308) execute only on the master rank and the ==2/==3 branches execute only on non-master ranks.
L2034: tau_crit_coh.inp is read with hard-coded loop bounds 'do L = 2, 4393' and 10 columns into TAUCRCOH(L,K) - grid-size assumption not derived from any input dimension.
L2596/L2622-L2624: WINDFA/WINDFB/WINDFC are multiplied by 4.42674E-10 unconditionally after the C46C read; comment L2619-2621 explains the units conversion, but re-running INPUT would re-scale.
L6869: TEMB(1) = ABS(TEMBO) uses TEMBO read at L2631 (card C46D, NASER>0 only); if NASER==0 TEMBO is used uninitialized here.
L3066-L3073 and L3088-L3098, L3166-L3197: cards C66A/C66B, C68, C69, C70, C73-C83 only set NCARD without any read - dead card slots retained for numbering.
L4460: inside the POCB.INP IREAD==1/else branch, STDOCB(:,:) = 0.0 is zeroed (not STPOCB) before reading STPOCB values - likely copy-paste from the DOCB block @L4315.
